t: How to become a debt buyer
s: March 25, 2021 - The most common entity in the debt buying industry and easiest to file for is an LLC (Limited Liability Company). This can be a good starting point, however an S Corp can be ideal for a collection agency with a monthly debt-buying budget whereas a C Corp may be better for a debt buying entity that is expected to make large purchases in which losses may be carried over across the fiscal year, or when expensive marketing campaigns are expected to create inconsistent revenue from year to year.
